```python
def median(values):
    if not values:
        raise ValueError("median() arg is an empty sequence")
    sorted_values = sorted(values)
    mid = len(sorted_values) // 2
    if len(sorted_values) % 2 == 0:
        return (sorted_values[mid - 1] + sorted_values[mid]) / 2
    return sorted_values[mid]
```
